papers.title: Emergent Gauge Flux in Mixed QED 3 with Flavor Chemical Potential: Implications for Magnetized U(1) Dirac Spin Liquids
papers.authors: Chuang Chen, Urban F. P. Seifert, Kexin Feng, Oleg A. Starykh, Leon Balents, Zi Yang Meng
papers.abstract: We design a lattice model of a “mixed” U(1) gauge field coupled to fermions with a flavor chemical potential and solve it with large-scale determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations. In this mixed construction, dynamical magnetic monopole events are suppressed in the temporal-continuum limit. For zero flavor chemical potential, the model realizes three-dimensional quantum electrodynamics ( QED 3 ) which has been argued to describe the ground state and low-energy excitations of the Dirac spin liquid phase of quantum antiferromagnets. At finite flavor chemical potential, which corresponds to a Zeeman field perturbing the Dirac spin liquid, we find a “chiral flux” phase which is characterized by the generation of a finite mean emergent gauge flux and, accordingly, the formation of relativistic Landau levels for the Dirac fermions. We use field-theory arguments to argue that in this state a U ( 1 ) m magnetic symmetry is spontaneously broken, leading to a gapless photon mode. Because of spin-flux attachment this mode would contribute to the low-energy longitudinal spin response. We numerically compute longitudinal and transverse spin structure factors which match our continuum and lattice mean-field theory predictions. In a different region of the phase diagram, strong fluctuations of the emergent gauge field give rise to an antiferromagnetically ordered state with gapped Dirac fermions coexisting with a deconfined gauge field. We also find an interesting intermediate phase where the chiral flux phase and the antiferromagnetic phase coexist. We argue that our results pave the way to testable predictions for magnetized Dirac spin liquids in frustrated quantum antiferromagnets.
papers.summary_en: This work uses a mixed U(1) lattice gauge theory and determinant quantum Monte Carlo to study QED₃ with a flavor chemical potential, motivated by magnetized Dirac spin liquids. It reports chiral-flux, antiferromagnetic, and coexistence regimes, with predicted spin responses linked to the emergent gauge field.

papers.relevance_reason: The simulations and field-theory analysis identify field-induced phases and spin-response signatures of a magnetized Dirac spin liquid, a substantive quantum-magnetism result.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究构建混合 U(1) 格点规范理论，并采用行列式量子蒙特卡罗研究带味化学势的 QED₃，旨在理解磁化 Dirac 自旋液体。研究报告了手征磁通相、反铁磁相及二者共存区域，并讨论了与涌现规范场相关的自旋响应。
papers.method_en: The authors design a mixed U(1) gauge-field lattice model coupled to fermions and solve it with large-scale determinant quantum Monte Carlo; in the temporal-continuum limit, this construction suppresses dynamical magnetic monopole events. They complement the simulations with field-theory arguments and continuum and lattice mean-field predictions, and compute longitudinal and transverse spin structure factors.
papers.method_zh: 作者构建了一个混合 U(1) 规范场与费米子耦合的格点模型，并用大规模行列式量子蒙特卡罗求解；在时间连续极限下，该构造会抑制动力学磁单极事件。他们还结合场论论证、连续与格点平均场预测，并计算纵向和横向自旋结构因子。
papers.result_en: At zero flavor chemical potential, the model realizes QED₃, which has been proposed as a description of Dirac spin liquids. At finite flavor chemical potential, corresponding to a Zeeman perturbation, the authors find a chiral-flux phase with finite mean emergent gauge flux and relativistic Landau levels for the Dirac fermions. Field-theory arguments indicate spontaneous breaking of U(1)ₘ magnetic symmetry in this phase, implying a gapless photon mode that would contribute to the low-energy longitudinal spin response. The calculated spin structure factors agree with the stated continuum and lattice mean-field predictions. Elsewhere in the phase diagram, strong gauge-field fluctuations produce antiferromagnetic order with gapped Dirac fermions and a deconfined gauge field, and an intermediate regime exhibits coexistence of antiferromagnetism and chiral flux.
papers.result_zh: 在味化学势为零时，该模型实现 QED₃；此前有研究提出以此描述 Dirac 自旋液体。在有限味化学势下——对应于塞曼扰动——作者发现手征磁通相，其中存在非零平均涌现规范磁通，Dirac 费米子形成相对论朗道能级。场论论证表明，该相中 U(1)ₘ 磁对称性会自发破缺，从而产生无能隙光子模，并对低能纵向自旋响应作出贡献。计算得到的自旋结构因子与文中给出的连续及格点平均场预测相符。在相图的其他区域，强规范场涨落导致反铁磁有序、Dirac 费米子开隙而规范场保持去禁闭；两者之间还出现反铁磁序与手征磁通共存的区域。
papers.future_en: Further work could test the predicted longitudinal and transverse spin responses in frustrated antiferromagnets under a Zeeman field, as proposed by the authors. Studies could also examine whether the predicted chiral-flux, antiferromagnetic, and coexistence regimes are realized across the relevant parameter space in candidate Dirac spin liquids.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可按作者提出的方向，在塞曼场作用下的受挫反铁磁体中检验其预测的纵向与横向自旋响应。还可进一步考察候选 Dirac 自旋液体在相关参数范围内是否实现手征磁通相、反铁磁相及其共存区域。

papers.title: Nonrelativistic Optically Induced Spin Torque in Noncollinear Magnets
papers.abstract: Manipulating spin using contactless and non-invasive optical approaches is one of the forefront topic in the modern spintronic science and technology. Prior studies on optically-induced spin reorientation usually scales with spin-orbit coupling strength, setting a limitation on composing heavy elements. In this work, we extend such a limit into nonrelativistic regime by exploring noncollinear magnetic configuration. Using a general spin group-theoretical investigation, we show how the symmetric operators in both spin and lattice spaces control the spin torque and quantum geometry of Bloch wavefunction--including both quantum metric and Berry curvature. We describe their site-resolved spin symmetries and unravel their selection rules. Furthermore, we adopt a Kagomé lattice model and a realistic material family to showcase the local spin torque under light irradiation. Since the nonrelativistic spin splitting usually spans on the order of electron-volt, significantly larger than typical spin-orbit induced splitting, the nonrelativistic light-induced spin torque is concomitantly much stronger. This work extends the previous opto-spintronics from relativistic to nonrelativistic limit, significantly broadening its realization platform.
papers.summary_en: This work develops a group-theoretical framework for optically induced spin torque in noncollinear magnets without relying on spin–orbit coupling. A kagome-lattice model and a realistic material family are used to illustrate the predicted local torque under light irradiation.

papers.physics_advance: Symmetries of spin and lattice operators can generate optical spin torque in noncollinear magnets even without relying on spin-orbit coupling, with associated selection rules and quantum-geometric effects.
papers.relevance_reason: Theoretical analysis of optically driven torque in noncollinear magnets establishes a condensed-matter spin-dynamics mechanism and predicts its realization in magnetic materials.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究建立了一个用于描述非共线磁体中光诱导自旋力矩的群论框架，其机制不依赖自旋—轨道耦合。作者通过 kagome 晶格模型和一类真实材料展示了光照下预测的局域力矩。
papers.method_en: The authors analyze spin and lattice symmetries using spin-group theory, deriving selection rules and relating symmetric operators to spin torque and Bloch-state quantum geometry. They then apply the framework to a kagome-lattice model and a realistic material family.
papers.method_zh: 作者利用自旋群理论分析自旋与晶格对称性，推导选择定则，并关联对称算符、自旋力矩与布洛赫态量子几何。随后，他们将该框架应用于 kagome 晶格模型及一类真实材料。
papers.result_en: The work identifies how symmetric operators in spin and lattice spaces govern optically induced torque and the quantum metric and Berry curvature of Bloch wavefunctions, and it specifies site-resolved spin symmetries and selection rules. The kagome model and realistic material family illustrate local spin torque under irradiation. The authors argue that, because nonrelativistic spin splitting is typically on the order of electron-volts and exceeds typical spin–orbit-induced splitting, the resulting torque can be much stronger than its relativistic counterpart.
papers.result_zh: 研究阐明了自旋空间与晶格空间中的对称算符如何控制光诱导力矩以及布洛赫波函数的量子度规和 Berry 曲率，并给出了位点分辨的自旋对称性与选择定则。kagome 模型和真实材料类别展示了光照下的局域自旋力矩。作者指出，非相对论自旋劈裂通常达到电子伏特量级，显著大于典型的自旋—轨道诱导劈裂，因此相应力矩可能远强于其相对论对应形式。
papers.future_en: Experimental work could test the predicted site-resolved selection rules and local spin torque under optical irradiation in suitable noncollinear magnets. Further studies could assess how the proposed nonrelativistic response compares with spin–orbit-driven optical torque across the material family considered.
papers.future_zh: 后续实验可在适当的非共线磁体中检验所预测的位点分辨选择定则及光照下的局域自旋力矩。还可在所讨论的材料类别中进一步评估这种非相对论响应与自旋—轨道驱动光学力矩的相对强度。

papers.title: Observation of quantized charge accumulation in a quantum anomalous Hall system
papers.authors: Yuanze Li, Jiahao Chen, Renfei Wang, Yifan Zhang, Yingdong Deng, Jin Xie, Xufeng Kou, Yang Liu, Tian Liang
papers.abstract: The quantum anomalous Hall effect in magnetically doped topological insulators exhibits a quantized Hall conductance σxy = e2/h arising from the two-dimensional surface states. While conventional transport probes confirm this quantization, they remain insensitive to the field-induced surface charge accumulation as a direct manifestation of σxy. Here, we experimentally validate an out-of-plane capacitive method that directly detects this quantized charge accumulation in a quantum anomalous Hall system. Using Corbino and simple disk devices, we measure charge accumulation proportional to field variation ΔB, with dissipation characterized by longitudinal conductance σxx and frequency f. A quantitative dissipation model extracts the intrinsic quantized charge density η0 = (e2/h)ΔB, which is confirmed through f- and σxx-dependent measurements. Under ultra-low dissipation (σxx ≈ 10−9 S), we directly resolve the fully quantized charge accumulation. This methodology establishes a direct charge-accumulation probe and provides a pathway toward detecting the topological magnetoelectric effect, a condensed matter manifestation of the four-dimensional quantum Hall effect. The quantum anomalous Hall effect in a magnetically doped topological insulator exhibits a quantized Hall conductance. Here, the authors demonstrate an out-of-plane capacitive method that directly measures field-induced quantized charge accumulation originating from the quantized Hall conductance.
papers.summary_en: This work demonstrates an out-of-plane capacitive method for directly detecting field-induced charge accumulation in a quantum anomalous Hall system. Under ultra-low dissipation, it resolves charge accumulation consistent with the quantized Hall conductance.

papers.physics_advance: Field-induced charge accumulation in a quantum anomalous Hall system is directly measured and shown, after accounting for dissipation, to follow the quantized density η₀ = (e²/h)ΔB.
papers.relevance_reason: It directly probes a distinctive quantized response of a quantum anomalous Hall material and resolves the quantized charge accumulation in the low-dissipation regime.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究展示了一种面外电容测量方法，可直接探测量子反常霍尔系统中由磁场诱导的电荷积累。在耗散极低时，实验分辨出与量子化霍尔电导相符的电荷积累。
papers.method_en: The authors measure charge accumulation in Corbino and disk devices using an out-of-plane capacitive technique while varying the magnetic field. They model dissipation in terms of longitudinal conductance σxx and frequency f, and use measurements with different f and σxx to extract the intrinsic response.
papers.method_zh: 作者采用面外电容技术，在 Corbino 和圆盘器件中测量磁场变化引起的电荷积累。他们建立以纵向电导 σxx 和频率 f 表征的耗散模型，并通过改变 f 与 σxx 的测量提取本征响应。
papers.result_en: The measured charge accumulation is proportional to the field variation ΔB, with its observed magnitude affected by dissipation. The quantitative model yields an intrinsic quantized charge density η₀ = (e²/h)ΔB, consistent with the frequency- and σxx-dependent measurements. At ultra-low dissipation, σxx ≈ 10⁻⁹ S, the experiment directly resolves the fully quantized charge accumulation. The authors present the method as a direct probe of charge accumulation associated with the quantum anomalous Hall response and as a possible route toward detecting the topological magnetoelectric effect.
papers.result_zh: 测得的电荷积累与磁场变化 ΔB 成正比，其观测幅度受耗散影响。定量模型提取出的本征量子化电荷密度为 η₀ = (e²/h)ΔB，与频率及 σxx 依赖的测量结果一致。当耗散极低、σxx ≈ 10⁻⁹ S 时，实验直接分辨出完全量子化的电荷积累。作者将该方法视为探测量子反常霍尔响应所伴随电荷积累的直接手段，并提出其可能用于探测拓扑磁电效应。
papers.future_en: Follow-up experiments could test the capacitive probe in regimes with varied frequency and longitudinal conductance, extending the characterization of its dissipation dependence. The proposed application to the topological magnetoelectric effect remains a direction for future experimental investigation.
papers.future_zh: 后续实验可在不同频率和纵向电导条件下检验该电容探针，进一步刻画其耗散依赖性。将该方法用于探测拓扑磁电效应仍有待未来实验研究。

papers.title: Thermodynamic demonstration of tetracriticality and multicomponent superconductivity in UTe2
papers.authors: Sahas Kamat, Jared Dans, Shanta Saha, Artem D. Kokovin, Johnpierre Paglione, Jörg Schmalian, B. J. Ramshaw
papers.abstract: The candidate topological superconductor UTe2 exhibits a complex phase diagram with multiple superconducting states, and the nature of their coexistence is not yet resolved. In particular, the apparent observation of two intersecting second-order phase boundaries at a triple point in the pressure–temperature phase diagram is thermodynamically forbidden. This suggests either a hidden phase transition or a fundamental misunderstanding of the superconductivity in this material. Here we observe an additional phase boundary that is characterized by an upward jump in the sound velocity. This is direct thermodynamic evidence for a phase transition in which superconducting order is lost on cooling. Our results establish a tetracritical point beyond which the ambient and pressure-induced superconducting order parameters form a multicomponent state. We use the measured phase diagram to demonstrate that strong competition between the two superconducting order parameters drives the loss of order when cooling, and leads to phase locking that suppresses superconducting fluctuations. These findings provide the definitive magnetic field–pressure–temperature phase diagram of UTe2 and establish a thermodynamic foundation for multicomponent superconductivity. Prior measurements of the phase diagram of UTe2 contain a triple point that is forbidden by thermodynamics. Now, an additional phase boundary is discovered that resolves this problem and confirms multicomponent superconductivity in this material.
papers.summary_en: This study resolves a thermodynamic inconsistency in the pressure–temperature phase diagram of UTe₂ by identifying an additional phase boundary. The resulting phase diagram supports a tetracritical point and a multicomponent superconducting state formed from ambient-pressure and pressure-induced order parameters.
papers.summary: The candidate topological superconductor UTe2 exhibits a complex phase diagram with multiple superconducting states, and the nature of their coexistence is not yet resolved. In particular, the apparent observation of two intersecting second-order phase boundaries at a triple point in the pressure–temperature phase diagram is thermodynamically forbidden. papers.physics_advance: An additional phase boundary establishes a tetracritical point where ambient-pressure and pressure-induced superconducting order parameters form a multicomponent state, with competition and phase locking accounting for the loss of order on cooling.
papers.relevance_reason: It provides direct thermodynamic evidence that resolves the UTe2 superconducting phase diagram and establishes multicomponent superconductivity in a quantum material.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究通过发现一条额外相界，解决了 UTe₂ 压力—温度相图中的热力学矛盾。由此得到的相图支持四临界点的存在，并表明环境压力与压力诱导的超导序参量构成多组分超导态。
papers.method_en: The authors use sound-velocity measurements to identify an additional phase boundary, marked by an upward jump in sound velocity, and construct the magnetic-field–pressure–temperature phase diagram. They interpret the measured phase boundaries in terms of competition and coupling between the two superconducting order parameters.
papers.method_zh: 作者通过声速测量识别出一条额外相界，其特征是声速向上跃变，并据此构建磁场—压力—温度相图。他们结合测得的相界，分析两个超导序参量之间的竞争与耦合。
papers.result_en: The additional boundary provides direct thermodynamic evidence for a transition in which superconducting order is lost upon cooling. Its identification resolves the previously reported triple-point inconsistency and establishes a tetracritical point. Beyond that point, the ambient-pressure and pressure-induced superconducting order parameters form a multicomponent state. The authors attribute the loss of order on cooling to strong competition between the order parameters, and report that phase locking suppresses superconducting fluctuations. The resulting phase diagram is presented as a thermodynamic foundation for multicomponent superconductivity in UTe₂.
papers.result_zh: 额外相界为一种随降温而失去超导序的相变提供了直接热力学证据。该相界的发现消除了此前相图中三相点与热力学不相容的问题，并确立了四临界点。在该点之外，环境压力与压力诱导的超导序参量形成多组分态。作者将降温时序的消失归因于两个序参量之间的强竞争，并指出相位锁定会抑制超导涨落。所得相图为理解 UTe₂ 的多组分超导性提供了热力学基础。
papers.future_en: Further work could test the reported order-parameter competition and phase locking with independent probes across the identified phase boundaries. The magnetic-field–pressure–temperature phase diagram also provides a basis for examining how the multicomponent state evolves under changes in field and pressure.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可利用独立实验探针，在已识别的相界附近检验所提出的序参量竞争与相位锁定。该磁场—压力—温度相图也为进一步考察多组分态随磁场和压力变化的演化提供了依据。
